scientific_integrity: Full proof relies on the Moore adjacency identities and the standard ordinary pebble-game equivalence. Exhaustive computations corroborate only the three existing graphs; no claim about infinite search or exhaustive priority is made.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for finite diameter-two Moore graphs, the pure equality-and-adjacency signature, and counting-free logic. The width-four result separates degree three from degrees at least four, not all possible higher degrees. Existence of degree 57 is not asserted; independent audit and exhaustive priority confirmation are not available.
title: Exact low-variable logical separation of diameter-two Moore graphs
